paragraphs: Players may choose to move their Units with the Standard Move.
See rule 144. for more information on the Standard Move.
Spells, Abilities, or other effects may cause a Move to occur.
The source of the Move will provide details on any restrictions on legality for Destination.
Units cannot Move to a Battlefield that already has units from 2 other players present by any means.
The Destination becomes Contested if it is an Uncontested Battlefield not controlled by the controller of the Unit or Units that moved.
Units may cause a Non-Combat Showdown when they Move.
See rule 341. Showdowns for more information.
Units may cause Combat when they Move.
See rule 461. Combat for more information.
When a Move action is complete, perform a Cleanup.
A Recall is when a Permanent is relocated from anywhere to its Base without it being a Move.
They do not cause Triggered Abilities to trigger that are triggered by Move actions.
A Recall causes a Permanent to change locations.
A Recall cannot be prevented by actions and Game Effects that restrict or block Movement.
When an un-attached non-Unit Gear without deploy is created or played at a battlefield, or is at a battlefield for any other reason, it is Recalled to its controller's base during the next Cleanup.
Example: An Equipment is attached to a unit at a battlefield, so the Equipment is present at that battlefield. If the unit dies, the Equipment will be recalled during the next cleanup.
